The email-change mail was most likely copied from the sign-up mail. It probably builds its URL from frontendDomain + '/confirm-email', which is the same path userSignUp uses. It may also reuse the sign-up i18n keys and the activation.hbs template. The link then opens the sign-up activation page. That page posts the hash to the sign-up confirm endpoint rather than the confirm-new-email endpoint, so the email change is never completed. The path should be '/confirm-new-email'.
